assessment: Delivery is visible at individual sites, but the evidence is not sufficient to say the whole system is on track. Regional grid access, dependable power and phased commissioning determine whether new supply meets new demand at the right place and time. This tracker is a selected project sample, not a national supply-demand balance.
gaps: Match each region’s dependable supply, transmission capability and commissioning dates to its load forecast.
Verify operational MW and actual electricity output instead of treating spending, signed contracts or queued projects as delivered supply.
Preserve phased schedules and unknown capacity; do not sum generation, storage, transmission and data-center ratings.
